newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soy lower late as soymeal drops, thin volume.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soy lower late as soymeal drops, thin volume.

text.p: CBOT soybean futures were lower in late dealings amid thin volume with commission house and local selling in soymeal leading the way down, traders said.
"It's coming out of meal but it's so thin it doesn't take much to move it right now," a trader said.
Traders said fundamentals were little changed with near-ideal crop weather in South America continuing to weigh on the market.
At 1232 CST, soybeans were 4-3/4 to six cents per bushel lower, with January down 4-1/2 at $7.02-1/2.
